# arin_rpki_setup (Data Source)

Inspect a delegated RPKI or publication setup document locally. Parses the four RFC 8183 exchange types and checks the BPKI CA self-signature. Does not enroll an organization, authenticate the document's source, submit correspondence, generate keys, or execute provisioning/publication operations. No API key or network access is needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arin_rpki_setup" "parent" {
  xml = file("${path.module}/parent-response.xml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `xml` (String, Sensitive) RFC 8183 child_request, parent_response, publisher_request or repository_response XML from a trusted out-of-band exchange. Use file() or base64decode() on a ticket attachment. Limited to 4 MiB; retained in state.

### Read-Only

- `bpki_ta_pem` (String) Self-signed BPKI CA certificate in PEM form. The self-signature and CA properties are checked; authenticity must be established out of band.
- `bpki_ta_sha256` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the DER certificate.
- `child_handle` (String) Child handle, if applicable. A parent may assign a handle different from the child's request.
- `id` (String) SHA-256 of the exact input XML bytes.
- `message_type` (String) Parsed setup message type.
- `not_after` (String) Certificate validity end, in UTC RFC 3339 format. Expired documents remain readable.
- `not_before` (String) Certificate validity start, in UTC RFC 3339 format. Validity is not checked against the current time.
- `parent_handle` (String) Parent handle, if applicable.
- `publication_offered` (Boolean) Whether the parent response includes a publication-service offer.
- `publisher_handle` (String) Publisher handle, if applicable.
- `referrals` (Attributes List) Ordered publication referrals. Authorization tokens are preserved without CMS verification; this data source does not grant or authenticate publication access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--referrals))
- `rrdp_notification_uri` (String) Optional RRDP notification URI. Never followed.
- `service_uri` (String) Provisioning or publication HTTP(S) endpoint. No request is made.
- `sia_base` (String) Repository's allocated rsync publication base.
- `tag` (String) Optional exchange tag, with XML token whitespace normalized.

<a id="nestedatt--referrals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `referrals`

Read-Only:

- `authorization_base64` (String, Sensitive) Opaque authorization CMS token, normalized as base64. Signature and contents are not verified.
- `contact_uri` (String) Optional contact URI. Never followed.
- `referrer` (String) Referring publisher handle.
